name: Formaldehyde / Formaldehyde-Releasers
reason: Known human carcinogen and strong skin allergen. Banned or heavily restricted in EU cosmetics.

name: Phthalates (DBP / DEHP)
reason: Endocrine disruptor linked to hormone irregularities and reproductive issues. Banned in EU cosmetics.

name: Triclosan
reason: Antimicrobial agent that disrupts thyroid and reproductive hormones. Banned in EU wash-off cosmetics.

name: Hydroquinone (OTC)
reason: Skin-bleaching agent banned in OTC products in the EU due to risks of ochronosis (permanent skin discoloration) and potential toxicity.

name: Coal Tar Dyes (PPD)
reason: Carcinogenic petroleum byproduct frequently contaminated with heavy metals. Banned or highly restricted globally.

name: Isobutylparaben / Isopropylparaben
reason: Endocrine-disrupting preservative that mimics estrogen. Banned under EU cosmetic standards.

name: Sulfates (SLS / SLES)
reason: Aggressive surfactant that strips natural lipids, causes chronic dryness, and compromises sensitive skin barriers.

name: Synthetic Fragrance / Parfum
reason: Top cause of cosmetic contact dermatitis. Often contains undisclosed endocrine-disrupting phthalates.

name: Mineral Oil / Liquidum Paraffinum
reason: Occlusive petroleum derivative that blocks pores, traps dirt, and can exacerbate cystic acne-prone skin.

name: Toluene
reason: Potent neurotoxin and endocrine disruptor commonly found in nail products and hair dyes.

name: Butylated Hydroxyanisole / Hydroxytoluene (BHA / BHT)
reason: Preservative linked to skin depigmentation, hormone disruption, and aquatic eco-toxicity.

name: Oxybenzone (Benzophenone-3)
reason: Chemical sunscreen filter linked to cell damage, hormone disruption, and significant coral reef bleaching.

name: Polyethylene Glycol (PEGs)
reason: Enhancer that increases skin penetration but is often contaminated with carcinogenic 1,4-dioxane.

name: Siloxanes / Silicones
reason: Synthetic silicones that accumulate in pores, dry out skin over time, and persist in the environment.

name: Synthetic Colors (D&C / FD&C)
reason: Coal tar derivatives linked to skin sensitivity, ADHD in children, and heavy metal impurity risks.
